description: Systems do not limit or respond to unsuccessful logon attempts. This signal indicates that accounts may be vulnerable to brute force or password guessing attacks without lockout or delay mechanisms.
applicability: Applicable to all authentication systems including operating systems, applications, network devices, and cloud services. Includes account lockout policies, rate limiting, and progressive delays.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through review of account lockout policies, authentication rate limiting configurations, and failed login monitoring.

sources.title: 32 CFR Part 170 - Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification Program
